description: Weighted scoring rubric for the Enterprise AppSec Benchmark Suite. Defines category weights, metric weights, grade thresholds, and penalty rules.

SAST.description: Static Application Security Testing - largest scenario pool (80 benchmarks), critical for development-time detection

DAST.description: Dynamic Application Security Testing - runtime vulnerability detection (20 benchmarks)

SCA.description: Software Composition Analysis - supply chain security (40 benchmarks)

SECRET.description: Secret Scanning - credential and API key detection (30 benchmarks)

CONTAINER.description: Container Security - Dockerfile and image misconfiguration detection (20 benchmarks)

IAC.description: Infrastructure as Code Security - Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm misconfigurations (20 benchmarks)

CICD.description: CI/CD Pipeline Security - GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipeline misconfigurations (10 benchmarks)

grade_descriptions.A+: Exceptional - Best-in-class detection with near-zero false positives and strong AI capabilities
grade_descriptions.A: Excellent - Comprehensive detection across all categories with very low noise
grade_descriptions.A-: Very Good - Strong detection with minor gaps in some categories
grade_descriptions.B+: Good - Solid detection but notable false positive or false negative patterns
grade_descriptions.B: Above Average - Reliable core detection but gaps in advanced categories
grade_descriptions.B-: Adequate - Functional detection but significant room for improvement
grade_descriptions.C+: Below Average - Misses many findings or generates excessive noise
grade_descriptions.C: Poor - Significant detection gaps across multiple categories
grade_descriptions.D: Very Poor - Major deficiencies in detection capability
grade_descriptions.F: Failing - Does not meet minimum benchmarks for production use

critical_miss_penalty.description: Penalty applied when a HIGH or CRITICAL severity vulnerability is missed (FN)

excessive_fp_penalty.description: Penalty when false positive rate exceeds threshold

category_zero_penalty.description: Penalty when a vendor scores zero in an entire category

benchmark_difficulty_multipliers.description: Multipliers applied to benchmark difficulty levels when computing weighted scores

minimum_viable_thresholds.description: Minimum thresholds a vendor must meet to be considered production-ready
